title: Buccal fat pad-derived stem cells with anorganic bovine bone mineral scaffold for augmentation of atrophic posterior mandible: An exploratory prospective clinical study
authors: Khojasteh A, Hosseinpour S, Rezai Rad M, Alikhasi M, Zadeh HH. Clin Implant Dent Relat Res. 2019 Apr;21(2):292-300. doi: 10.1111/cid.12729.
supports: Clinical study from the botiss cerabone (sintered bovine bone) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “The authors concluded that BFPSCs may be an alternative to autologous bone in alveolar ridge reconstruction as no differences in bone volume formation between the groups were found” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
